mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCmStndrdCatalogDetailPopList*/ SELECT (SELECT CATEG_PATH FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID = X.CMS_CATEG_ID) AS CATEG_PATH, -- [03] X.CMS_CATLG_ID AS CMS_CATLG_ID, -- [04] X.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION_LOC, -- [02] X.DESCRIPTION_ENG AS DESCRIPTION_ENG, -- [06] X.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, -- [07] (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M104' AND CODE = X.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_NAME, -- [08] X.MAKER_CODE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = X.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_NAME, -- [09] X.ORDER_MEASURE, X.STD_FLAG, X.REMARK, X.CMS_CATEG_ID, X.ITEM_GROUP, X.ORIGIN_CODE, X.ITEM_GUBUN, X.ONOFF_TYPE, X.STD_FLAG, X.IMG_FLAG, MODEL_INFO FROM CMSCATLG X WHERE X.CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_cms_catlg_id} AND X.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: UPDATE CMSCATLG SET CMS_CATEG_ID=#{st_cms_categ_id}, DESCRIPTION_LOC=#{st_description_loc}, DESCRIPTION_ENG=#{st_description_eng}, REP_SEPCIFICATION = #{st_specification}, SPECIFICATION=#{st_specification}, MAKER_CODE=#{st_maker_code}, MAKER_NAME=#{st_maker_name}, ORIGIN_CODE=#{st_origin_code}, ORDER_MEASURE=#{st_order_measure}, STD_FLAG=#{st_std_flag}, CHANGE_USER_ID=#{st_user_id}, REMARK=#{st_remark}, MODEL_INFO=#{st_model_info}, ITEM_GUBUN=#{st_item_gubun}, CHANGE_DATE=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), CHANGE_TIME=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') WHERE CMS_CATLG_ID = #{st_cms_catlg_id}
